title: How The Dutch Economy Shows We Can't Reduce Wealth Inequality With Taxes | Economics Explained
summary: An Economics Explained video arguing that the Netherlands shows taxes alone can't reduce wealth inequality. It distinguishes income inequality from wealth inequality and discusses the Gini index.
why: HN uses it to explain the difference between income and wealth inequality, though some pair it with a rebuttal.

quote.text: This video gives a good explanation about their difference
